def: to entwine, i.e. shut in (for formation, protection or restraint)

words.word: hast not thou made an hedge

occurrences.text: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
words: Hast not thou made an hedge

occurrences.text: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.
Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
